proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10187.11 *moṭṭa explicitly gives Gujarati moṭũ and Old Marwari moṭaü big/fat, alongside Bengali moṭā fat. These o-vowel adjectives select section 11, not unextended *muṭṭa defective. Exact survey form moṭu is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10250 mūla explicitly gives Gujarati mūḷ root, whereas *mūḍa section 2 concerns a distinct northern retroflex series. The Bhil muḷ responses follow the Gujarati root family, without treating retroflex l alone as proof of *mūḍa. Exact survey form muḷ is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
